I'm now weighing the immediate advantages against potential downsides of property development. While building on the Yellow properties could boost my income significantly ($110/$110/$120 or $330/$110/$120), the risk of landing on `p1`'s expensive Oranges is high. Unmortgaging `VENTNOR_AVENUE` is looking better. If I build houses now, and then land on the Oranges next turn, the resulting losses are larger, even if I get some cash out of them! Also, all three opponents are about to roll, so let's unmortgage first.
